top_signals.title: Emaar Offers to Buy Out Construction Arm at $16.3 Billion Value
top_signals.summary: Dubai’s Emaar Properties PJSC offered to take over its construction arm in a multibillion-dollar deal at a time when valuations for both firms have been weighed down by the monthslong regional war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: South Korea’s AI Darlings Become Big Casualty of US Midterm Vote
top_signals.summary: South Korea’s Kospi Index slid as shares of chipmakers plunged on concern that a strong showing by Democrats in the US midterms would lead to greater scrutiny of the artificial intelligence industry.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Can India’s Debt-Fueled Spending Survive Higher Rates?
top_signals.summary:
India’s household borrowing surged 36% in a year, raising questions about how much consumer spending is being powered by debt and whether that growth can last as interest rates rise. Ruchi Bhatia explains.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: Florida voters passed sweeping property tax cuts in Tuesday’s election, a move that will gut local government funding.
